pairs.zh: 我們的顧客比我們可以計數的更多。

pairs.en: We have no choice but to risk it.
pairs.zh: 我们别无选择只能冒着危险。

pairs.en: We have plenty of time to spare.
We have so many things left to do.
pairs.zh: 我们有许多未完成的事。

pairs.en: We have to come to some agreement.
We have to continue to do our jobs.
pairs.zh: 我们要继续我们的工作。

pairs.en: We have to find out where Tom is.
pairs.zh: 我们必须查明汤姆在哪里。

pairs.en: We have to fix the date for our trip quickly.
pairs.zh: 我们必须快点定下旅游日期。

pairs.en: We have to try to communicate with them.

pairs.zh: 这个学期我们有两次考试。

pairs.en: We have your size, but not in that color.
pairs.zh: 我们有你的尺寸，但是没有那个颜色。

pairs.zh: 我們還沒吃完這個西瓜。

pairs.zh: 我們聽見了他下樓的聲音。

pairs.en: We hope a solution is found.
pairs.zh: 我们希望找到解决方法。

pairs.en: We hope you will enjoy the show.
pairs.zh: 我們希望你喜歡這個表演。

pairs.en: We import tea from India.

pairs.zh: 我们刚好有时间吃早饭。

pairs.en: We know that all men are mortal.
pairs.zh: 我們知道人皆難免一死。

pairs.en: We know the identity of Tom's killer.
pairs.zh: 我㥃知道了湯姆的殺手的身份。

pairs.en: We left the final decision to him.
pairs.zh: 我們讓他做最後的決定。

pairs.en: We made an appeal for support.
pairs.zh: 我們提出了請求支持的呼籲。

pairs.en: We made every effort to help him.
pairs.zh: 我們盡了一切努力來幫助他。

pairs.zh: 我們把牛奶製成乳酪和奶油。

pairs.zh: 我們在校園附近的咖啡廳碰面。

pairs.zh: 我們在學校前面見面了。

pairs.en: We must cancel our trip to Japan.
pairs.zh: 我們必須取消我們去日本的旅行。

pairs.en: We must conform to the rules.

pairs.zh: 周四早上之前我们要全部完成。

pairs.en: We must get up at dawn.
We must learn to live in harmony with nature.
pairs.zh: 我们必须学会与自然和谐共处。

pairs.en: We must never confuse the two.

We must reduce energy demand.
pairs.zh: 我们必须降低能源需求。

pairs.en: We must respect other people's privacy.
pairs.zh: 我們必須尊重別人的私隱。

pairs.en: We must try to break the deadlock.
pairs.zh: 我们必须设法打破这个僵局。

pairs.en: We need an ambulance.
We often associate black with death.
pairs.zh: 我们常把黑色跟死亡联系起来。

pairs.en: We often eat fish raw in Japan.
pairs.zh: 我們在日本常常吃生魚。

pairs.en: We often watch TV while we're eating breakfast.
pairs.zh: 我们常在吃早饭时看电视。

pairs.en: We ought to obey the law.
We owe you an apology.

pairs.zh: 我们用了一整天打扑克。

pairs.en: We postponed our departure because of the storm.
pairs.zh: 我們因為風暴推遲了起程。

pairs.en: We really appreciate their effort.
pairs.zh: 我们真的感激他们的努力。

pairs.en: We receive many telephone calls from abroad.
pairs.zh: 我們接到許多來自國外的電話。

pairs.en: We require your help.

pairs.zh: 我们坐着谈很久以前的事。

pairs.en: We saw a funny movie last Sunday.
pairs.zh: 我們上星期天看了一場很有趣的電影。

pairs.en: We saw many ships in the harbor.
pairs.zh: 我們在港口裡看到了許多船。

pairs.en: We saw the child get on the bus.
We saw the ground covered with snow.
pairs.zh: 我们看见地面被雪覆盖了。

pairs.en: We set a trap to catch a fox.
pairs.zh: 我们设了个陷阱来抓狐狸。

pairs.en: We should abolish the death penalty.
We should ban advertising aimed towards children.
pairs.zh: 我们应该禁止针对儿童的广告。

pairs.en: We should cancel the hike.
pairs.zh: 我們應該取消這次遠足。

pairs.en: We should have taken the schedule into consideration.
pairs.zh: 我们本该考虑一下行程。

pairs.en: We should tell children how to protect themselves.
pairs.zh: 我们应该告诉孩子怎么保护自己。

pairs.en: We shouldn't expect too much help from Tom.
pairs.zh: 我們不該期望從Tom那得到太多幫助。

pairs.en: We spent the entire day on the beach.
We stayed overnight in Hakone.
We still have many other things to discuss.
pairs.zh: 我们还有许多别的事情要讨论。

pairs.en: We take health for granted until illness intervenes.
pairs.zh: 我們視健康為理所當然, 直到疾病侵襲。

pairs.en: We talked about a variety of topics.
We talked and talked until the day broke.
pairs.zh: 我們一直聊天直到天明。

pairs.en: We thought his threat was only a joke.
pairs.zh: 我们觉得他的威胁只是一个玩笑。

pairs.en: We took a walk along the river.
We took part in the discussion.

pairs.zh: 我们采取了强有力的预防措施。

pairs.en: We traveled to Mexico by plane.

pairs.en: We tried to compromise with them.
We use a lot of water every day.

pairs.zh: 过去我们每个周末都去溜冰。

pairs.en: We went down a river by canoe.
pairs.zh: 我們乘著獨木舟向河的下游而行。

pairs.en: We went for a walk in the forest.
We went to Russia.
We went to the mountains to ski.
We were able to catch the last train.
pairs.zh: 我们能赶上最后一班火车。

pairs.en: We were in danger of losing our lives.
pairs.zh: 我们曾有失去生命的危险。

pairs.en: We were just about to enter the room.
We were nearly frozen to death.
We were on the same train by chance.
pairs.zh: 我们偶然间乘了同一列列车。

pairs.en: We were on the train for ten hours.
pairs.zh: 我們在火車上十個小時。

pairs.en: We will begin the party when he comes.
pairs.zh: 他来了，我们就开始派对。

pairs.en: We will continue the meeting after some light refreshments.
pairs.zh: 茶点过后我们接着开会。

pairs.en: We will go on a picnic tomorrow.

pairs.zh: 我们只会在那样的条件下同意。

pairs.en: We will reach London before dark.
pairs.zh: 我們會在天黑前到達倫敦。

pairs.en: We will take part in the marathon.

pairs.zh: 我们起得很早为了看到日出。

pairs.en: We won the battle.

pairs.zh: 我们做这事没有额外报酬。

pairs.en: We won't go out unless it stops raining.
pairs.zh: 除非雨停了，我们才会出去。

pairs.zh: 我們需要人力仲介公司幫我們找到合適的人來擔任這個管理職位。

pairs.en: We'll think about it in due time.
We're both reasonable people.
pairs.zh: 我们是两个通情达理的人。

pairs.en: We're expecting a good harvest this year.
We're going to eat a lot tonight so I hope you're not on a diet.
pairs.zh: 我们今晚会吃很多，所以我希望你没有在节食。

pairs.en: We're going to have to change our plans.
pairs.zh: 我們快要到必須改變我們計畫的時候了。

pairs.en: We're going to stay in Boston all month.
pairs.zh: 我們整個月都要待在波士頓。

pairs.en: We're on strike because the company hasn't improved our wages.
pairs.zh: 我們罷工是因為公司沒有改善我們的工資。

pairs.zh: 衛生紙用完了，我必須去買。

pairs.en: We're ready for the next step.
pairs.zh: 我們準備好了走下一步。

pairs.en: We've been living here since July.
pairs.zh: 從七月開始我們一直住在這裡。

pairs.en: We've got to have determination.
Wealth does not always bring us happiness.
pairs.zh: 財富並不總是為我們帶來快樂。

pairs.zh: 如果天气允许的话，我们1小时后出发。

pairs.en: Welcome to our home.
Welcome to your new home.
Well, the night is quite long, isn't it?
Were you a soldier?
Wet clothes stick to your skin.
What I want is some peace and quiet.
pairs.zh: 我所想要的是一点平和和安静。

pairs.en: What I'm about to say is strictly between you and me.

What a bizarre story!
What a pity you can't dance!
What an idiot I am!

What did you do with my glasses?

pairs.zh: 她十三岁的时候离家出走了。

pairs.zh: 你若是傷害別人，你也會傷害到自己。
